assets.prompt: Create the ACTUAL in-card illustration for the collectible campus card '静园读书人' (Quiet Garden Reader) in PKUARDS. This is a small gameplay card illustration, not a landscape, poster, screenshot, or card frame. Landscape 3:2. ONE clearly adult Chinese university student in his early twenties with short dark hair, round glasses, a warm ochre/tan coat over a muted jade sweater and a small dark red scarf, holding an open cream book at chest height. A focused, curious expression, looking up from the book, three-quarter head-and-chest close-up. The character and book together fill at least 75 percent of the canvas; large clearly readable face, face and torso dominate the center, cropped just below the hands, top of head fully within the frame. The open book and hands must be anatomically clean and visually simple. Strong warm silhouette and distinctive readable gesture at 160px wide. Restrict campus background to softly suggested pale red traditional courtyard wall and a few ginkgo leaves at the edges, with very low detail and low contrast. Stronger contrast on face, glasses, hands, and book. Quiet scholarly human warmth with an energetic collectible-card focal point. Warm cream paper, lake jade, ochre, restrained dark red, charcoal ink. Full bleed art. NO text anywhere, NO letters, NO title, NO numbers, NO logos, NO watermark, NO border, NO UI. NO distant or tiny person, NO full body, NO multiple characters, NO scenic panorama, NO elaborate architecture, NO photographic realism, NO anime, NO 3D. B: elegant limited-color carved woodcut illustration on cream uncoated paper, rich ink shapes, selective fine hatch marks, strong graphic readable human silhouette. Jade, ochre, brick red and charcoal, vintage book illustration rather than a propaganda poster.
